description: the same ball drilled through beside its axis by a cylinder of radius 0.6 leaning 0.1 in x, its wall 0.4 clear of either pole: a sphere and a cylinder on skew axes meeting in two traced loops fitted to NURBS (ADR-0018), Viviani's curve opened up — each loop crosses the sphere's seam and the drill's. Moved off the pole on purpose: with the wall through the south pole Open CASCADE builds no solid at all, which is the next step's pose (a section through a pole), not this one's
